svg.aria-label: Debsourya Datta. A spinning ASCII torus, an agent core, circled by memory, skills, tools, timers, heartbeat and ask human. Builds AI agents and software in Bangalore, usually still at it around 2 AM, talks AI and agents most days on SouryaTalks.
